Enum Class Enums.SpectrumKind

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Enums.SpectrumKind>
global.thalion.ttio.Enums.SpectrumKind
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Enums.SpectrumKind>, Constable
Enclosing class:
Enums
public static enum Enums.SpectrumKind extends Enum<Enums.SpectrumKind>
Kind of spectrum, derived from the persisted @spectrum_class attribute string.

The persisted string remains the source of truth and is written verbatim; this enum exists only to replace stringly-typed dispatch with typed switches. Each member carries its canonical persisted string. fromPersisted(String) maps an absent (null/empty) class to MASS (the v0.1 fallback) and any unrecognized string to UNKNOWN.

Cross-language equivalents: Python SpectrumKind.
